message:
docs(field-test): drop the HQ-switch framing the logs do not support

No measurement changed here; the way three of them were described did.

The logs carry no event for the reported 17:18:10 high-quality switch -- the
host's runtime-config goes from 17:15:04.060 straight to 17:18:52.258 -- so
splitting the run into "before" and "after" that moment reads a boundary into
the evidence that isn't there. Section 5.5 now says what the log says: the
session ran at 12 Mbps from start to finish, and the terminal nack-spent
events began at 17:16:05.873.

The 6.25-second repaint of seq=2308 moves into the body of 5.2, with the
resemblance to the 0.2.103 old-seq repaint stated as resemblance only --
same-shape is not same-cause, for the same reason the 11:27 comparison is
fenced off.

Also records that .claude/ is untracked, so the preserved excerpts are not
committed and the row counts, sizes and hashes in 2.2 are what a later copy
would be checked against.

Documentation only -- no re-query of the NAS, no product change, no build.
